summary: Add an opt-in query parameter versions=latest to GET /api/v1/issues/{key}/references: each member's artifact.versions holds only its latest version, with its own ETag variant; without it (or with versions=all) the answer stays byte-identical. The dispatch CLI (packages/envoy-client getIssueReferences, shipped in pi-envoy) sends it. The loader gets a lateral latest-version query and a pointer map (R17). INFRA-650's test cleanup, grown to real size. refseed committed into packages/envoy/loadtest as part of stack.sh seed with a keyless version-count file, after sjawhar/legion#2369 is on main (forward merge; no READY without it). Merge rule on INFRA-589's route mix with the CLI line sending ?versions=latest.
